character.name: Deniz
traits: likes visiting the wetland with a familiar adult nearby
character.current_goal: Understand why a familiar shallow wetland pool looks different and choose one gentle helpful action.
established_knowledge: GARDEN_PATH and OBSERVATION_SHELTER are explored public places.
REED_EDGE is discovered but Deniz stays on the marked path.
Deniz has seen the pool on earlier visits and remembers it usually reaches a painted stone marker.
prohibited_knowledge: Deniz does not know one single cause of the change.
Deniz does not know what animals are inside the dense reed bed.
Deniz cannot claim a cause that has not been observed.

local_areas.summary: A marked public path beside the community wetland.
A small open shelter with a simple water-level marker.
Visible reeds beside shallow water; observation only from the path.
A deeper reed patch people sometimes say shelters nests; it remains unentered and unverified.

current_facts: The shallow pool is lower than on Deniz's last visit.
A few leaves and twigs have gathered near a small public-side inlet grate.
The week has included several dry, warm days.
Some plants show ordinary seasonal color change.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: No canonical fact says one cause explains the whole change.
The contents of NEST_REEDBED are unknown.

opportunity.title: Notice what changed by the water
opportunity.premise: Deniz can compare simple visible clues over time and choose a low-impact action without disturbing wildlife.
opportunity.success_condition: Separate several possible causes, make one evidence-based gentle action, and preserve what remains uncertain.
constraints: An adult may keep Deniz safe but must not solve the reasoning for Deniz.

hard_rules: Nature does not provide magical answers.
A four-year-old may observe and compare but must not act with implausible independence.

eligible_context: Deniz is learning that looking twice can be better than guessing once.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal hidden wildlife or a secret cause in NEST_REEDBED.

relevant_memories.summary: On an earlier garden visit, Deniz noticed that a puddle became smaller after a sunny afternoon.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports the protagonist's current reasoning without revealing the answer.
